english.title: Unlawfully disclose information received from the Commissioners for HMRC - Plant Health Regs 2019
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 44 and 48 of the Official Controls (Plant Health and Genetically Modified Organisms) (England) Regulations 2019.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
disclosed
information relating to a person
whose identity is specified in the disclosure OR
whose identity can be deduced from the disclosure
the disclosure is for a purpose other than specified in regulation 34(1) AND
the Commissioners have not given their prior consent to the disclosure

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 45 provides the defence of lawful disclosure.
(ii) Where an offence under these Regulations is proved to have been committed with the consent or connivance of an officer, or to be attributable to any neglect on the part of an officer, the officer as well as the body corporate, is guilty of an offence and is liable to be proceeded against and punished accordingly.
(iii) "Officer" in relation to a body corporate means a director, manager, secretary or other similar officer of the body, or a person purporting to act in such capacity.
(iv) Where an offence under these Regulations is committed by a partnership or an unincorporated association bringing proceedings against the partnership or association in the name of the partnership or association, see regulation 47.

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 3 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None
